# Personal Data Protection Act 2012

Status: Current version as at 15 Oct 2026

An Act to govern the collection, use and disclosure of personal data by organisations, and to establish the Do Not Call Register and to provide for its administration, and for matters connected therewith.

Be it enacted by the Parliament of Singapore as follows:

## Contents

Part 1

PRELIMINARY

Part 2

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION COMMISSION AND ADMINISTRATION

Part 3

GENERAL RULES WITH RESPECT TO PROTECTION OF AND ACCOUNTABILITY FOR PERSONAL DATA

## Part 1 PRELIMINARY

1. This Act is the Personal Data Protection Act 2012.

2. In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires, "business contact information" means an individual's name, position name or title and any other similar business contact details of the individual.
